message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck works best with 4–8). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first turn goes to the player left of the dealer. “Reverse” flips the direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either:
• the color of the top discard card, **or**
• the number/symbol of the top discard card.
• A Wild card can be played on any card. | | **Special Cards** | | **Effect** | | Skip | Next player loses their turn. | | Reverse | Reverses play direction. | | Draw Two | Next player draws two cards and loses their turn. | | Wild | You choose the new color. | | Wild Draw Four | You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. **(Must be played only if you have no matching color; otherwise you can be challenged.)** | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of the cards left in each opponent’s hand:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points.
Winner gets that total added to their score. | | **Game End** | Play continues until a player reaches the target score (usually 500). | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on the discard pile** – knowing what’s coming can help you plan your moves. 2. **Use Wild Draw Four wisely** – it’s powerful but risky if you’re caught. 3. **Watch your opponents’ “UNO” calls** – they’re a good indicator of how close they are to winning. 4. **House rules** – feel free to tweak: e.g., “Draw Two” can be stacked, or “Wild Draw Four” can be played even if you have a matching color. Enjoy the colorful chaos!
